reviews.title: Self Applauding UI
reviews.text: I was enjoying my morning coffee when I overheard a bird call I had not yet heard before in the mornings where I live. I immediately wanted to know what the bird was so I found this app and downloaded it hoping to identify the bird before it stopped calling. Upon downloading the app I was forced to watch this 45 second “tutorial”. The entire time the bird was still calling. By the time the video ended, the bird had stopped singing and I was completely unable to identify it. Why the developers of this app felt it necessary to subject its users to mandatory tutorial that feels less educational and more like an excuse to show off their advanced coding skills is beyond me. To make matters worse I was then immediately prompted to start my free trial. Luckily this isn’t my first rodeo so to speak so I knew this wasn’t mandatory but full screen prompts for subscriptions with tiny x’s in the corner are extremely predatory cash grabs.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: I have used the around identifier a few times now , once by accident inside a train and it said that it was a kestrel when it was just people talking, I’ve just used it on my bedroom trying to identify some very noisy birds that I can see and the app says that they are owls which they are not so I lost trust in this app

reviews.title: Poor accuracy
reviews.text: I was trying to test the accuracy of the app and took various photos of statues and other items without any birds and got some pretty weird answers. Results like birds from Ecuador, Australia and countries far away from the United States. How can the app return bird species without a bird being present?  I also recorded a mourning dove and the app said it was a bird from coastal Europe.

reviews.title: Bad identification
reviews.text: This program identifies everything as a northern cardinal. Even a hummingbird!  We have both types and both sexes of cardinal, chickadees, finches, buntings and more but to this program they are ALL northern cardinals. So disappointing
